prompts.orbit: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for Bullets of Fury, an original military science-fiction HD 16-bit arcade shooter. Generate a finished, extremely wide seamless horizontally scrolling PIXEL ART panorama, landscape 3:1 composition, no text and no user interface. Scene: low orbit above the curved blue Earth at night, distant illuminated coastal cities along the lower horizon, immense dark indigo space, restrained cobalt and violet nebula clouds and small crisp stars, subtle orange distant atmospheric flashes. Premium hand-authored Neo Geo / late Sega arcade pixel clusters, sharp one-pixel stair steps and deliberate metallic color ramps, no soft airbrush, no vector style, no painterly smudges, no photorealism. Dark readable central two-thirds for the existing game logo and menu lettering; strongest detailed scenery toward the bottom and edges. Broad landscape continues naturally at left and right edges, matching edge colors and horizon for seamless horizontal tiling. No ships, characters, logos, buttons, captions, grids, borders, or mockup. Actual game background art, not a presentation. Full bleed artwork. Preserve layered depth between far space and near atmosphere so separate parallax layers can accompany it.
